name: Design Seeds · Nature Tones

title.zh: Design Seeds · 从自然灵感图和色条组合里找配

description.zh: 看Nature Tones的野花与六条色带，作为配色参考。 Design Seeds是Jessica Colaluca创办的配色灵感归档，以自然灵感照片搭配色条组合，并可按颜色标签浏览。2024年About将本站定位为有限灵感库而非正式色卡，指向Instagram的Full Seeds；图片分享须署名回链且不得修改，颜色创作与原图权利分开。
description.en: Design Seeds is Jessica Colaluca’s color-inspiration archive, pairing photographs with swatches and color-tag browsing. Its 2024 About page describes a limited inspiration library and points to Full Seeds on Instagram. Image sharing requires attribution, a link to the original post and no modifications; color creation and photograph rights remain separate.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Design Seeds (https://www.design-seeds.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Nature Tones的野花与六条色带，作为配色参考。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页野花与玫瑰配色，再到归档页比较海滩、月亮照片旁的色条；广告遮住底部，范围只算清楚可见部分。Nature Tones详情展示野花与六条浅绿色，画面没有可读HEX，适合找方向而非精确色彩标准。2024年About说本站保留有限灵感库；图片分享须署名回链且不能修改，颜色创作与原图权利分开。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
